entities.summary: The Art of Living Foundation is a volunteer-based, non profit, humanitarian and educational non-governmental organization (NGO). It was founded in 1981 by Ravi Shankar with the vision of creating a stress-free and violence free society,in Bengaluru, India, which also serves as the location of its international centre. The Art of Living Foundation has centers in 180 countries.
